description: This file defines an abstract class 'ContentActivity' for workflow activities related to content management within OrchardCore. It includes methods for handling content items, evaluating expressions, and managing workflow states.

classes.name: ContentActivity
classes.description: An abstract class for content-related workflow activities, providing methods for content retrieval, expression evaluation, and workflow state management.

classes.name: ContentItemIdExpressionResult
classes.description: A helper class implementing IContent, representing a content item identified solely by its ID.

methods.name: OnInputReceivedAsync
methods.description: Handles input reception, updating the InlineEvent context based on input data.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Returns a successful outcome indicating the activity has completed.

methods.name: OnWorkflowRestartingAsync
methods.description: Restores the content item in the workflow context when a workflow restarts, based on input data.

methods.name: GetContentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the content item based on the workflow context and expression evaluation.

methods.name: GetContentItemIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates and retrieves the content item ID from the workflow context.
